All fixtures contain original synthetic pixels and use MIT OR Apache-2.0.
They were generated on 2026-10-25 using ImageMagick and libjxl 0.11.2.
No external artwork is included.

rgba-lossless.jxl: a 4x3 RGBA8 grid listed in tests/jpeg_xl.rs, encoded with
ImageMagick from raw RGBA at quality 100. Independently decoding with ImageMagick
reproduces all 48 source bytes, including partial alpha.
oriented-lossless.jxl: the same input encoded with -orient RightTop. The
codestream orientation must rotate it clockwise once into a 3x4 document.
rgba-container.jxl: the same lossless codestream inside JPEG XL signature,
ftyp and jxlc boxes; ImageMagick independently opens the container.
gray16-lossless.jxl: a 5x3 16-bit grayscale black-to-white gradient encoded at
quality 100. Independent 8-bit decoding gives rows 0, 128 and 255.
linear-icc.jxl: examples/linear_profile_probe.rs produces a two-pixel PNG with
a linear RGB ICC profile, converted to JPEG XL at quality 100. The gray pixel
has stored RGB 128 and alpha 37; sRGB conversion produces approximately 188.
animation.jxl: two 2x2 frames, red then blue, each with a delay of 10 centiseconds,
encoded at quality 100. Both frames have nonzero duration. Import selects the
first displayed frame; animation editing is not provided.
oversized-width.jxl: a 17000x1 black image used to verify the import dimension limit.

rgba-export.jxl: the RGBA grid re-encoded by examples/raster_export.rs using the
locally patched zune-jpegxl 0.5.2. Independent ImageMagick/libjxl decoding matches
all original RGBA bytes exactly.
thin-export.jxl: an original 1x257 RGBA ramp with pixel i equal to
[(37*i)%256, (91*i)%256, (17*i+200)%256, (51*i)%256], exported by the same encoder.
Independent ImageMagick/libjxl decoding matches all 1028 bytes exactly. These
checks include fully transparent hidden RGB and a group-boundary transition.

resolution-export.jxl: the original 300x150 uniform-color, 300 DPI document from
examples/resolution_probe.rs exported through examples/raster_export.rs. It stores
only application-owned EXIF X/Y resolution and unit tags in a JPEG XL container.
ImageMagick independently reports 300x150 pixels and 300x300 PixelsPerInch.
